## Menu bar
- When a suggestion is waiting (a Writing Style or AI app proposal), its row in the menu now starts with the same dot as the menu bar icon and says "This is what the dot on the menu bar icon means".

## Fixes
- Dictate Prompt with a template: when an entry is highlighted, the hint in the quick-action card now says what ↩ actually does (format with the template), instead of naming the highlighted action.
- Internal cleanups in quick-action handling, Hub snapshot loading and log reading, with no change in behavior.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.96...v8.97
